newsitem.title: UK: Cirqual positive on current year business.
newsitem.headline: Cirqual positive on current year business.

text.p: Aluminium company Cirqual Plc said on Tuesday that its business in the current financial year was better than last year.
"The ongoing businesses have achieved both turnover and profits which are significantly ahead of the same stage last year," Tony Gartland told shareholders at the company's annual general meeting.
Gartland said aluminium shapes had made good progress with the relocation of the finishing operation to Corby proceeding according to plan.
He said the firm's EPOS data strip market was doing well as it had just received a substantial order from Sainsbury's for the supply of data strip for all existing and new stores.
"The Cirqual group, including Wollaston, is currently performing well ahead of expectations for 1996/97," the chairman said.

Its Wollaston unit recently got approval to become a designated British Aerospace repair station. The company is now awaitng approval from the Federal Aviation Administration which is expected in two months.
"This excellent start to the financial year continues to lead the directors to believe that Cirqual can look forward to the future with confidence," Gartland said.
